base_url.description: TrueNAS API base URL, eg. https://your.nas/api/v2.0

command.description: Command or script that runs on schedule

hide_stderr.description: if `false` any error output is mailed to the user account used to run the command

hide_stdout.description: if `false` any standard output is mailed to the user account used to run the command

user.description: Account that is used to run the job

block.description: TrueNAS allows users to run specific commands or scripts on a regular schedule using cron(8). This can be helpful for running repetitive tasks.

acl_mode.description: Determine how chmod behaves when adjusting file ACLs. See the zfs(8) aclmode property.

atime.description: Choose 'on' to update the access time for files when they are read. Choose 'off' to prevent producing log traffic when reading files

name.description: Unique identifier for the dataset. Cannot be changed after the dataset is created.

sync.description: Sets the data write synchronization. `inherit` takes the sync settings from the parent dataset, `standard` uses the settings that have been requested by the client software, `always` waits for data writes to complete, and `disabled` never waits for writes to complete.

block.description: A TrueNAS dataset is a file system that is created within a data storage pool. Datasets can contain files, directories (child datasets), and have individual permissions or flags

comment.description: Any notes about this NFS share

quiet.description: Restrict some syslog diagnostics. See exports(5)

security.description: Security mechanism activation state and priority. Requires NFSv4. sys, krb5, krb5i, krb5p

block.description: Creating a Network File System (NFS) share on TrueNAS gives the benefit of making lots of data easily available for anyone with share access. Depending how the share is configured, users accessing the share can be restricted to read or write privileges. To create a new share, make sure a dataset is available with all the data for sharing.

acl.description: Enable support for storing the SMB Security Descriptor as a Filesystem ACL

comment.description: Any notes about this SMB share

durablehandle.description: Enable SMB2/3 Durable Handles: Allow using open file handles that can withstand short disconnections

fsrvp.description: Enable support for the File Server Remote VSS Protocol.

guestok.description: Allow access to this share without a password

hostsdeny.description: Disallowed hosts (IP/hostname). Pass 'ALL' to use whitelist model.

name.description: SMB share name. Defaults to last part of shared path.

path_suffix.description: Append a suffix to the share connection path. This is used to provide unique shares on a per-user, per-computer, or per-IP address basis.

purpose.description: You can set a share purpose to apply and lock pre-determined advanced options for the share.

shadowcopy.description: Export ZFS snapshots as Shadow Copies for Microsoft Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) clients

streams.description: Enable Alternate Data Streams: Allow multiple NTFS data streams. Disabling this option causes macOS to write streams to files on the filesystem.

timemachine.description: Enable TimeMachine backups to this share

vuid.description: Share VUID (set when using as TimeMachine share)

block.description: SMB (also known as CIFS) is the native file sharing system in Windows. SMB shares can connect to any major operating system, including Windows, MacOS, and Linux. SMB can be used in TrueNAS to share files among single or multiple users or devices.

autostart.description: Set to start this VM when the system boots

cores.description: Specify the number of cores per virtual CPU socket. The product of vCPUs, cores, and threads must not exceed 16.

memory.description: Allocate RAM for the VM. Minimum value is 256 * 1024 * 1024 B. Units are bytes. Allocating too much memory can slow the system or prevent VMs from running

shutdown_timeout.description: The time in seconds the system waits for the VM to cleanly shut down. During system shutdown, the system initiates poweroff for the VM after the shutdown timeout has expired.

threads.description: Specify the number of threads per core. The product of vCPUs, cores, and threads must not exceed 16.

vcpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs to allocate to the virtual machine. The maximum is 16, or fewer if the host CPU limits the maximum. The VM operating system might also have operational or licensing restrictions on the number of CPUs.

attributes.description: Device attributes specific to device type, check VM resource examples for example device configurations

deduplication.description: Transparently reuse a single copy of duplicated data to save space. Deduplication can improve storage capacity, but is RAM intensive. Compressing data is generally recommended before using deduplication. Deduplicating data is a one-way process. *Deduplicated data cannot be undeduplicated!*.

force_size.description: The system restricts creating a zvol that brings the pool to over 80% capacity. Set to force creation of the zvol (not recommended)

inherit_encryption.description: Use the encryption properties of the root dataset.

name.description: Unique identifier for the volume. Cannot be changed after the zvol is created.

readonly.description: Set to prevent the zvol from being modified

sync.description: Sets the data write synchronization. `inherit` takes the sync settings from the parent dataset, `standard` uses the settings that have been requested by the client software, `always` waits for data writes to complete, and `disabled` never waits for writes to complete.

volsize.description: Volume size in bytes, should be multiples of block size

block.description: Manage ZFS Volume (zvol), use of TF `prevent_destroy` (https://www.terraform.io/docs/language/meta-arguments/lifecycle.html#prevent_destroy) flag is recommended to avoid accidental deletion
